title: LayerDrop depth plus Mirror surviving-layer roles
hypothesis: A compact affine depth-conditioned Givens view on LayerDrop-compatible shared layers recovers heldout shallow-depth functions with fewer bytes than independent depth maps and beats a static per-depth rank-one residual.
physical_object: One shared four-block nonlinear residual network
mirror_coordinate: Two coefficients define an angle as a function of active depth, applied to the surviving hidden state
logical_multiplicity: Depths 1,2,3,4; fit depths 1 and 4, hold out 2 and 3
controls: independent full effective output map per depth
success_gate: Fresh Mirror heldout NRMSE <=1e-4, <=50% bytes of independent maps, and a better quality/byte point than native and static rank-one control in all worlds.
failure_gate: Mirror does not improve the preregistered frontier or a simple control matches quality at equal/lower bytes.
boundaries: Synthetic LayerDrop-compatible mechanism only; no trained LayerDrop Transformer, language NLL, GPU or natural-task evidence.
Teacher is an affine Givens depth orbit, favorable to the candidate.
